title: Edge-index sidecar read latch never releases after a completed watcher rebuild
wanted_capability: bbox_reindex (and any caller gated on the sidecar-publication read guard) should be admitted once the edge-index watcher rebuild completes. Observed live (2026-08-14): the watcher logged "EdgeIndex rebuilt ... elapsed_ms=12529" and the runtime went idle, yet bbox_reindex kept refusing with "an edge-index rebuild is already reading the sidecar publication" for 10+ minutes until a daemon restart, with repeated "deferred a store-only nudge" warnings in the same window (prime suspect for a set-without-release path). Wanted: exit-path-audited release (or an RAII guard) on the latch across success, deferral, and error paths; a release log line; and an owner timestamp on the guard so a stale hold is detected and reported instead of impersonating an active rebuild.
missing_primitive: exit-path-audited release on the sidecar publication read latch
fallback_used: Daemon restart clears the latch (at the cost of restarting any in-flight schema rebuild, which is expensive).
evidence: daemon log 2026-08-14: rebuild complete 03:45:29 vs refusals through 03:54+
